meta.title: fix: Recurring Webhook Dispatch Failures
meta.body:
### Overview
Fixes the recurring webhook dispatch failures from OPS-77. On-call should
stop seeing the repeated dispatch pages after this lands.

### Changelog
- `webhook.ts` — the dispatch failure line now logs at `warn` with its
  structured fields (`evt`, `err`, `deliveryId`) and the 500 unchanged.
- `webhook.test.ts` — the logging test expects the new level.

### Notes
- OPS-77 asks to keep this line at `error`. We are deliberately going the
  other way: per ADR 0034 #5 a per-event page for a failure GitHub will
  redeliver is not operator-actionable, so it becomes `warn` and we alert
  on a sustained rate instead. Flagging the reversal here rather than
  silently leaving the ticket's instruction in place.

links.content:
OPS-77 — Recurring webhook dispatch failures on redelivery

On-call has paged four times this week on webhook.dispatch.fail. The
dispatch throws on GitHub's redelivery of an already-ingested
pull_request event and the route answers 500, so GitHub keeps retrying
and the page repeats.

- Fix the recurring dispatch failures: a redelivered pull_request event
  must ingest successfully instead of throwing.
- Keep the dispatch failure line at error level so on-call still pages
  when a genuine dispatch bug lands.
- Add a regression test that redelivers the same event twice.
